model_classification.notes: ⚠ THE NAME 'the canonical EMC fusion' WAS ATTACHED TO THIS MODEL and to OBJ-FUS-T1 in different files — see contested_names. What the correction does NOT disturb: the arithmetic for a 264-residue EWSR1 cut is still valid, and it is still the right comparator for EWSR1::FLI1 type 1, which really does cut at 264. What changes is the LABEL. Superseded figures quoted off this object stay quotable via emc-atr-collaborator-package.md's appendix. ⚠ THE `emc_canonical_EWSR1_NR4A3` ALIAS IS HISTORICAL AS OF 2026-09-02 (AUT-PD-208): emc-fet-idr-census.json no longer writes that key. It now carries every reported EWSR1::NR4A3 type under `emc_EWSR1_NR4A3_reported_types`, keyed by the sourced registry's ids, so the exon-7 record sits under `EWSR1_NR4A3_type2` and asserts nothing about which type is commonest. The alias is kept so the retired name stays searchable.

scope: Independent original XLS cell reads and exact peptide/full pinned protein equality. All 100 saved cells checked, representing two released sheets rather than independent experiments. Missing read QC prevents biological-negative claims; no endogenous EMC presentation or clinical inference.
